subject: Missing values are displayed at the tail end of the range in qvis

messages.author: cd79cb369362d1a4
messages.subject: Missing values are displayed at the tail end of the range in qvis
parts:
> df <- data.frame(x = rnorm(10), y = c(rnorm(8), NA, NA))
> qvis(df, ~y, ~x) # There are 10 points when there should only be 8! The two missing values for Y appear as -2.
